title: Compute a nonzero selected quadratic echo defect
statement: In full projected forced Euler around a=alpha F,F=e1 sin(kappa x2),kappa=2pi, use f=a_t and w=e2 cos(kappa x1)+e3 cos(kappa x2). Exact identities L_F w=0 and B(w,w)=-kappa e3 cos(kappa x1)sin(kappa x2) give, for initial rho w, second-variation coefficient w2(5T)=kappa e3 sin(kappa x2)integral_0^(5T)cos[kappa x1+kappa Theta(s)sin(kappa x2)]ds,Theta=integral alpha. The rational profile satisfies integral Theta=0 and integral_0^5 G(z)^2 dz=583/96,G=integral g. Relative to unforced w2_zero=5kappa T e3 cos(kappa x1)sin(kappa x2), the small-AT defect is -(583 kappa^3/192)A^2T^3 e3 cos(kappa x1)sin^3(kappa x2)+O(A^3T^4). If kappa|AT|<=1/4, its L2 norm>=(583 kappa^3/384)sqrt(5/32)A^2T^3. This is an exact selected INVISCID coefficient, not an all-input nonlinear flow lower bound or large-impulse instability theorem.
